purpose: Original executable output for fidelity investigation; not yet an application parity test.
platform: Original Linux x86-64 programs executed through Docker Desktop on Apple Silicon; pgvector/pgvector:pg16 container, network disabled, no database connection.
observations: Two triangles linked by an edge are one connected fixed point at peel 2, including the linking edge.
The pendant edge belongs to peel 1; its attachment vertex therefore belongs to both fixed-point buildings.
The peel-2 wave output assigns wave 1 and levels 0/1 to the edges. Preserve original row semantics rather than inferring floors from k-core bands.
Maximum vertex ID is 6. The Makefile derives this value from the final source ID in fixture.cc, not the connected-component count.
